facts.text: The milestone was announced at the 3rd Department of Health Research (DHR)-ICMR Health Research Excellence Summit, which concluded today at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi.

Organised by DHR and ICMR on 16 and 17 November 2026, the two-day Summit brought together over 600 scientists, researchers, innovators, administrators and policymakers from ICMR institutes, partner institutions, government organisations and academia.
The Summit also marked 115 years of ICMR's contribution to biomedical and health research in the country.
The top 100 school students selected through the SHINE National Competition were also recognised at the Summit for their contributions and scientific thinking in public health.

items.summary: Developed indigenously by ICAR-NIHSAD, Bhopal, the vaccine is the first of its kind in India against the H5N1 HPAI virus of Clade 2.3.2.1a. Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI), commonly known as bird flu, is a serious disease affecting poultry.

facts.text: Developed indigenously by ICAR-NIHSAD, Bhopal, the vaccine is the first of its kind in India against the H5N1 HPAI virus of Clade 2.3.2.1a.
Outbreaks can cause nearly 100 per cent mortality among infected birds, leading to major financial losses for poultry farmers due to the large-scale culling of birds and restrictions on trade.
Since the first detection of the disease in India in 2006, more than 500 combined outbreaks of H5N1 and H5N8 subtypes have been reported in the country.

A major outbreak of bird flu could reduce India's GDP growth by up to 1.5 per cent, while more than 20 per cent of the country's poultry population could be at risk if the disease spreads without control.

facts.text: Charting Path towards 156 GW and Beyond 18 NOV 2026 11:00AM by PIB Delhi Wind Energy: Expanding Capacity, Strengthening Energy Security Wind energy is emerging as a key pillar of India’s transition towards a cleaner and more sustainable energy future.
As of 30 September 2026, India’s total installed renewable energy capacity stood at 299.25 GW .
Wind power accounted for 59.20 GW , representing approximately 19.8% of the total installed renewable energy capacity.
Between March 2014 and September 2026, installed wind capacity grew from 21 GW to 59.20 GW, nearly a 2.8-fold increase , reflecting wind energy’s growing role in India’s renewable electricity mix.

facts.text: The MAS intervention aims to strengthen India's export market access through structured support for activities such as Buyer-Seller Meets (BSMs), Reverse Buyer-Seller Meets (RBSMs), trade fairs, exhibitions and other related market access initiatives.
The Union Cabinet approved the EPM on 12 November 2025, with an outlay of ₹25,060 crore for the period FY 2025-26 to FY 2030-31.
